§ 168-169 ] NUMERALS AND THEIR DECLENSION.                109

G.      पञ्चनाम्    षण्णाम्     अष्टनाम्
L.      पञ्चसु     षट्सु      अष्टसु-अष्टासु

सप्त, नवन् and the following cardinals up to नवदशन् ought
to be declined like पञ्चन्.                 '                     ,

§ 167. ऊनविंशति, विंशति and other cardinal numbers up to 
नवनवति are all feminine substantives, the numerals शत, सहस्र,
&c. are all neuter, with the exception of लक्ष which is neu. and
fem. कोटि which is fem. and शङ्ख and जलधि both of which are
mas. and have no declensional peculiarities. They are
declined in the sing. and so used with a plural noun; e. g.
पञ्चविंशतिब्राह्मणाः: 25 Brāhmaṇas; एकादशाधिकशतेन or एका-
दशोत्तरेण शतेन नरैः or स्त्रीभिः: by 111 men or women; एकोनसहस्रेण
रूप्यकैः: with Rs. 999 &c. They may be made to have duals
and plurals by being used as fixed standards of counting; e. g.
ब्राह्मणानां विंशतयः: many twenties of Brāhmaṇas; द्वे शते नारीणाम्
two hundreds of women &c.

§ 168. The ordinals are declined regularly except:—

प्रथम ( see § 156 ) and द्वितीय and तृतीय which are optionally
declined like pronouns in the Dat. Ab. Gen. and Loc. sing ;
e. g. द्वितीयस्मै-द्वितीयाय, &c. द्वितीययाः:-द्वितीयस्याः: &c.

NUMERAL ADVERBS.

§ 169. ( a ) सकृत् once, द्विः twice, त्रिः thrice, चतुः four
times; from पञ्चन् onwards adverbs of frequency are formed by
adding कृत्वः before which final न् is dropped e. g. पञ्चकृत्वः five
times, सप्तकृत्वः seven times, &c.

( b ) एकधा* or ऐकध्यम् in one way or part, द्विधा or द्वेधा or द्वैधं
in two ways or parts, त्रिधा or त्रेधा or त्रैध्यम् in three ways, &c.;
चतुर्धा in four ways, षोढा or षड्धा in six ways, सप्तधा, अष्टधा, &c.

*संख्यायाश्च विधार्थे धा। आविःकरणावचाले च। एकाच्छो द्व्यष्टन्यतरस्याम्।
द्विन्नोऽथ धञ्च्। एतञ्च Pāṇ. V. 3. 42-46.
